Intertextuality is a method, skill, or discipline and a guide for the scientific analysis of texts, especially artistic and non-artistic works, to determine the presence of influence through borrowing or dialogue; that is, the similarity in form, content, and technique between one text and another. This resemblance can be direct or involve proximity. Such interaction is also referred to as an echo. It is believed that intertextuality is among the oldest compositional techniques; however, as a critical approach, it still appears to be unfamiliar and has not been extensively addressed in the field of Kiswahili literature and art. For this reason, this article will contribute to the Kiswahili body of work dealing with criticism through the theory of intertextuality, in order to identify the intertextuality present in texts, for example in the play Our Cohesion Our Triumph. The results of the analysis have revealed a considerable presence of intertextuality connected to the author’s upbringing and development in religious (spiritual), physical (cultural and moral), social, and academic dimensions – in one way or another. It is part of these findings that constitutes this article. Therefore, this article presents the intertextuality between the selected play Our Cohesion Our Triumph and writings from sacred books, allegory in the selection and creation of characters, philosophical echoes, chapter or plot titles, and the mythology of symbols. The play employs language that is quickly and easily understood by anyone well-versed in Kiswahili. The dialogues constructed in this play evoke a variety of themes such as liberation, the role of women in society, social classes, sabotage, selfishness, intrigue, oppression, hatred, jealousy, greed, betrayal, exploitation, abuse, discrimination, transparency and truth, customs and traditions, unity and solidarity, family upbringing, effort and sustainable development, the importance of preserving records and identifying property, as well as the management and advancement of property, among others. What is important for the reader of this article to understand is that intertextuality cannot be identified in a text if the analyst lacks background knowledge or familiarity with the knowledge, techniques, skills, and traits found in various preceding texts. Therefore, a person who can identify intertextuality in artistic works must be a highly knowledgeable and inquisitive individual, someone with a thirst and hunger for knowledge, techniques, skills, and the characteristic curiosity gained through exploring various creative works and a range of academic writings. On the contrary, a reader will not be able to discern the intertextuality within the creative work they are reading if they do not mentally perceive the resonances of knowledge, techniques, skills, and traits found in earlier works. The play is rich in various artistic and theoretical experiments and techniques. For example, within the play, there is intertextuality as each chapter is given a subtopic that refers to linguistic terms from the field of structural linguistics, in order to illustrate the birth and development of the subject matter being discussed by the author. In this book, these scholars explain that, typically, the human brain has an area responsible for recording, storing, and rapidly retrieving memories of events and experiences a person has encountered. Therefore, when a reader comes across an event or technique that they have previously encountered in another work, their mind immediately responds and triggers a sensation that draws on the recall of that event or technique. The retrieval of a previous event, matter, or technique in relation to what has just been encountered produces an intersection of two texts. This intersection creates a resonance of the event, technique, or matter within the reader’s mind. All of these processes occur very rapidly. Therefore, you cannot recognize the presence of intertextuality if you are not a keen reader or a careful follower of different matters and various writings—both extensively and in depth. Allegory is an artistic device used by a writer to choose a name that reflects the character, behavior, and experiences of a character in the work they are creating. For example, a writer may name their character “Hasidi” (The Envious One). To justify this name, the writer must develop that character to act with envy from beginning to end. The selection and creation of characters whose traits align with their names is the artistic technique known as allegory. Normally, these characters possess the traits of flat characters (those who do not undergo changes in character) in order to justify their names, because if they were to change in character, their names would no longer correspond to their new traits. Therefore, in terms of character and stance, these characters remain unchanged from the beginning to the end of the play. Mlacha and Madumulla (1991) describe such characters as ones who do not appear to grow in character, actions, or psychologically. The main goal of this approach is to persuade the public to embrace good deeds and names that embody goodness, so as to reject evil and oppose the use of names that carry negative meanings, since African societies believe that a name shapes the character of the individual. An echo is a sound that is repeated after being produced, such as when a person shouts inside a cave or forest, while philosophy refers to the study of the nature, meaning, and reasons for things, as well as wisdom and prudence (Kamusi ya Kiswahili Sanifu, 2013). Therefore, a philosophical echo is a sound that is repeated after being produced through the study of the nature, meaning, and reasons for things, as well as wisdom and prudence. The play "Our Unity, Our Triumph" portrays a woman enduring intense and painful struggles for liberation. The play shows how the woman finds herself on the verge of despair, almost accepting defeat, but with the support of a large community that joins her, she ultimately emerges victorious. This is a philosophical echo that reminds us of the saying that one finger cannot kill a louse and that unity is always victory. According to the Standard Swahili Dictionary (TUKI, 2013), the word “word” is defined as a group of sounds that are spoken or written together to convey meaning. And so, when words are grouped into different units that have not yet reached the status of a clause or a sentence, they are called phrases (Kipacha, 2005). Therefore, a word and another word form a phrase. Likewise, when phrases are brought together, they form clauses. Massamba (2004) defines a clause as "a construction with a subject and a predicate that exists within a main construction." Several clauses combine to form a sentence; and when several sentences are brought together, they form a construction, which then forms a paragraph, and paragraphs in turn produce an essay. A sentence is a self-contained construction that essentially involves an action and an agent (TUKI, 2013). Moreover, the use of the snake as an artistic symbol is not limited to this play alone but also appears in other Kiswahili creative works. Oral literature, as an ancient art form, often employs large snakes and other creatures to represent God, gods, spirits, humans, or certain concepts through imagery. Kanuni hizi ni: (i) si rahisi na kwa hakika haiwezekani kuona maandishi kama bidhaa ambayo ni yatima, katika upekee wake na kutengwa; badala yake, tunapaswa kutambua kwamba kuna maandiko yaliyotangulia ambayo yanahusiana na maandishi mapya; (ii) matini huingiliana na kuathiriana, hivyo kufikiri kwamba matini ya fasihi inajitosheleza na inayojitegemea ni upofu wa kimakusudi; na (iii) matini ya kisanaa hualika namna fulani za kujieleza na kanuni maalum ambazo husaidia kuashiria wazo, tukio, kazi au kazi nyingine inayofuata—hivyo kuleta athari kwa kazi ya ubunifu inayofuata (Kristeva, 1980). Kwa kuzingatia kanuni hizi, tunaweza kusema kwamba mwingiliano wa matini ni nadharia na ujuzi wa kitaaluma ambao huchunguza, kubainisha, na kueleza uhusiano uliopo kati ya matini moja na nyingine, ili kubaini athari za moja kwa moja au zisizo za moja kwa moja (zilizoangaziwa) zinazotokana na mwingiliano na uimarishaji wa matini hizi. Uchanganuzi huo uliongozwa na nadharia ya Intertextuality. Nadharia hii ilitokana na mawazo ya mazungumzo ya mwanazuoni wa Kirusi, Mikhail Bakhtin (b. 1895, d. 1975), na baadaye ikaboreshwa na mwanasemiotiki wa Kifaransa, Julia Kristeva (Wamitila, 2002; Wafula na Njogu, 2007). Hapa ni sawa kusema kwamba Julia Kristeva ndiye mwanzilishi wa nadharia ya Intertextuality baada ya kuboresha nadharia ya Dialogism ya Mikhail Bakhtin katika miaka ya 1960. Bakhtin anatusadikisha kwamba kazi yoyote ya fasihi ina sauti mbalimbali. Mwingiliano huu, kwa maneno mengine, pia huitwa resonance. waliotengwa; hasa wanawake na watoto. Tamthilia hii inatathmini athari hizi na kisha kupendekeza jinsi ukombozi wa kiakili, kitamaduni na kijamii unavyopaswa kukuza umoja na ushirikiano ndani ya jamii kubwa zaidi ili kuwasaidia waliotengwa kujikomboa. Tamthilia hii hutumia lugha inayoeleweka kwa haraka na kwa urahisi na yeyote anayefahamu vyema Kiswahili. Mijadala iliyobuniwa katika tamthilia hii inaibua dhamira mbalimbali kama vile ukombozi, nafasi ya mwanamke katika jamii, matabaka ya kijamii, hujuma, ubinafsi, fitina, uonevu, chuki, wivu, uchoyo, usaliti, unyonyaji, unyanyasaji, ubaguzi, uwazi na ukweli, mila na desturi, umoja na mshikamano wa familia, umoja na mshikamano. na kutambua mali, pamoja na usimamizi na maendeleo ya mali, miongoni mwa wengine. Kilicho muhimu kwa msomaji wa makala haya kuelewa ni kwamba mwingiliano wa maandishi hauwezi kutambuliwa katika maandishi ikiwa mchambuzi hana ujuzi wa usuli au ujuzi wa maarifa, mbinu, ujuzi na sifa zinazopatikana katika matini mbalimbali zilizotangulia. Kwa hivyo, mtu anayeweza kutambua mwingiliano wa maandishi katika kazi za kisanii lazima awe mtu mwenye ujuzi wa juu na mdadisi, mtu mwenye kiu na njaa ya ujuzi, mbinu, ujuzi, na udadisi wa tabia unaopatikana kupitia kuchunguza kazi mbalimbali za ubunifu na maandishi mbalimbali ya kitaaluma. Kinyume chake, msomaji hataweza kutambua mwingiliano wa maandishi ndani ya kazi ya ubunifu anayosoma ikiwa hatatambua kiakili mwangwi wa maarifa, mbinu, ujuzi, na sifa zinazopatikana katika kazi za awali. Tamthilia hiyo ina majaribio na mbinu mbalimbali za kisanaa na kinadharia. Kwa mfano, ndani ya tamthilia hiyo, kuna mwingiliano wa matini kwani kila sura imepewa mada ndogo inayorejelea istilahi za kiisimu kutoka katika uwanja wa isimu miundo, ili kudhihirisha kuzaliwa na maendeleo ya jambo linalojadiliwa na mwandishi. Aina nyingine ya uasilianaji inapatikana katika matumizi ya vielelezo na picha, mbinu za usimulizi, na upanuzi usio wa kawaida wa mwelekeo wa jukwaa, pamoja na ujumuishaji wa ngoma, nyimbo, muziki, ushairi, majigambo, ubeti wa kwaya, na usawiri wa Joka (Mgimba, 2017). Aidha, hata uteuzi wa jina “Sumukuvu,” unaoakisi sifa na matendo yanayoashiria sifa za kitu fulani au kiumbe fulani, hudhihirisha kipengele kingine cha kazi: uwepo wa vipengele vya kawaida vya wahusika katika fasihi simulizi. Kwa mfano, mhusika Sumukuvu anaweza kuonekana ama kuwa ni mhusika wa kibinadamu mwenye jina linalofanana na sumu au mhusika kutoka katika fasihi simulizi ambaye ameigizwa mtu na kupewa uhai, kisha kutenda kama binadamu. Sababu hii inapatana na kile kinachofafanuliwa kwa kina na Taylor na Taylor (1983) katika kitabu chao kinachojulikana sana The Psychology of Reading. Katika kitabu hiki, wasomi hawa wanaeleza kwamba, kwa kawaida, ubongo wa mwanadamu una eneo linalohusika na kurekodi, kuhifadhi, na kurejesha kwa haraka kumbukumbu za matukio na uzoefu ambao mtu amekutana nao. Kwa hivyo, msomaji anapokutana na tukio au mbinu ambayo amekutana nayo hapo awali katika kazi nyingine, akili yake hujibu mara moja na kuamsha hisia inayotokana na kukumbuka tukio au mbinu hiyo. Urejeshaji wa tukio la awali, jambo, au mbinu kuhusiana na kile ambacho kimekutana hivi punde hutokeza makutano ya matini mbili. Makutano haya huunda mwangwi wa tukio, mbinu, au jambo ndani ya akili ya msomaji. Taratibu hizi zote hutokea kwa haraka sana. Kwa hiyo, huwezi kutambua kuwepo kwa mwingiliano wa maandishi ikiwa wewe si msomaji makini au mfuatiliaji makini wa mambo mbalimbali na maandishi mbalimbali—kwa upana na kwa kina. MUHTASARI WA CHEZA USHIRIKIANO WETU USHINDI WETU  
Mshikamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu ni mchezo wa Kiswahili wenye mwelekeo dhabiti wa ufeministi, unaojumuisha athari za tabia na matendo ya wanajamii fulani wanaoendeleza imani potofu, husuda, chuki, ubinafsi, na aina mbalimbali za dhuluma dhidi ya wengine.  
Katika sekta ya kilimo, Sumukuvu (mycotoxin) inarejelea sumu au kemikali zenye sumu zinazozalishwa na aina ya fangasi wanaojulikana kama Kuvu, ambao hukua na kushambulia mara kwa mara mazao ya chakula na mimea inayotoa mafuta, hasa ile yenye majani na mbegu, hasa nafaka, kunde, mizizi, karanga na vyakula vya mifugo ama shambani au kwenye hifadhi. Sumukuvu haionekani kwa macho lakini inaweza kugunduliwa kwa kutumia vipimo maalum vya maabara. Zaidi ya hayo, mchezo huu unabainisha picha kadhaa, ikiwa ni pamoja na joka, taa ya kijani, ukungu mnene, giza na ajali. Aina nyingine ya utajiri hupatikana katika semi mbalimbali, zikiwemo aina mbalimbali za tamathali za usemi kama vile mafumbo, nahau, methali, mafumbo na mafumbo. Vilevile, sambamba na huzuni, mwandishi ameingiza ucheshi kama njia ya kuleta faraja na kurejesha amani iliyokuwa imetoweka katika familia. KUHUSU MWANDISHI ANITHA ELIAS MGIMBA

INTERTEXTUALITY KATIKA USHIRIKIANO WETU USHINDI WETU  
Uchambuzi uliofanywa kwenye tamthilia hii umebaini kuwa kuna mwingiliano mkubwa wa matini ndani yake. Walakini, kwa madhumuni ya kifungu hiki, tutawasilisha mwingiliano wa maandishi unaohusiana na: maandishi kutoka kwa vitabu vitakatifu, fumbo katika uteuzi na uundaji wa wahusika, mwangwi wa kifalsafa, vichwa vya sura au njama, na hadithi za ishara, kama sehemu ya kuambatana na kikomo cha maneno kinachohitajika na jarida hili. Alipata elimu yake ya juu katika Chuo Kikuu cha Kikatoliki cha Mwenge kilichopo Moshi, Kilimanjaro (2014–2017), ambako alisoma na kuhitimu Shahada ya Kwanza ya Sanaa, taaluma ya Historia na Kiswahili, bila kusahau kozi ya Uandishi Ubunifu. Kwa sasa anaendelea na masomo zaidi— Shahada ya Uzamili ya Elimu ya Utawala na Mipango katika Chuo Kikuu cha Mtakatifu Augustine, Mwanza, Tanzania. Mbali na masomo yake ya kuhitimu, Anitha ni mwalimu wa shule ya sekondari, anayefundisha Historia na Kiswahili katika shule ya usharika wake iitwayo Mtakatifu Yohane Paulo II Iringa. Chakula anachopenda zaidi ni ugali na samaki. Pia anafurahia kutumikia jamii kupitia mafundisho. Anitha ni mchezaji bora wa netiboli aliyebobea katika nafasi ya golikipa (GK), jukumu analofanya vizuri sana ambalo limemuongezea umaarufu na heshima.

Jedwali hili linaonyesha dondoo tulizozibainisha kutoka katika tamthilia ya "Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu" ambazo zinafanana au zinalingana na nukuu za Biblia Takatifu. Huu ni ushahidi usiopingika kwamba tamthilia hii haikuundwa kutokana na hali mbaya ya hewa, bali mwandishi alichota ujuzi, ujuzi, na uzoefu kutoka katika maandishi matakatifu ya dini iliyomlea na kumlea, kama tulivyoona katika wasifu wa mwandishi. Manukuu yote tuliyorejelea yanaonyesha wazi mwangwi wa matini za awali, hivyo kuthibitisha kwa nguvu kwamba utungaji na uandishi hauwezi kutenganishwa na athari za matini zilizotangulia au mazingira ya kimwili na ya kiroho ambayo yalimuibua na kumtengeneza mwandishi. Ndiyo maana Worton na Still (1990) wanasisitiza kuwa kila andiko ni nyongeza ya matini nyingine. Hakuna maandishi ambayo yamekamilika na hayahitaji nyongeza kutoka kwa maandishi mengine ili kuwa na maana na kueleweka. Hii ina maana kwamba hakuna maandishi yanayofanya kazi kama mfumo funge, unaojitosheleza; badala yake, kila kifungu kinategemea maandishi yaliyotangulia. Zaidi ya hayo, athari hii ya mwingiliano wa maandishi unaotokana na kujifunza, kuishi kwa mujibu wa mafundisho ya dini, na kusoma vitabu vitakatifu haikomei kwa Anitha peke yake, bali pia imo katika kazi za ubunifu za waandishi mashuhuri kama vile Abdilatif Abdallah, Euphrase Kezilahabi, Mwanakupona Binti Mshamu, Sayyid Abdalla Bin Ali bin Nasir, Shaaban bin Nasir, Shaaban bin Nasir, Shaaban, Al-Ahmad Al-Ahmad. Mtu ambaye si msomaji wa maandiko matakatifu hawezi kutambua makutano ya mchezo huu na maandiko matakatifu, kama vile Biblia Takatifu, kwa sababu wanakosa mifano ya awali ambayo inaweza kuamsha hisia zao za utambuzi na kumbukumbu kupitia mwangwi wa matini. Kwa kawaida, wahusika hawa huwa na sifa za wahusika bapa (wale ambao hawafanyi mabadiliko ya tabia) ili kuhalalisha majina yao, kwa sababu ikiwa wangebadilika tabia, majina yao hayatalingana tena na sifa zao mpya. Kwa hiyo, mwangwi wa kifalsafa ni sauti inayorudiwa baada ya kuzalishwa kupitia uchunguzi wa asili, maana, na sababu za mambo, pamoja na hekima na busara. Mchezo wa kuigiza "Umoja Wetu, Ushindi Wetu" unaonyesha mwanamke akivumilia mapambano makali na maumivu ya ukombozi. Mchezo huo unaonyesha jinsi mwanamke huyo anavyojikuta katika hatihati ya kukata tamaa, karibu kukubali kushindwa, lakini kwa kuungwa mkono na jamii kubwa inayoungana naye, hatimaye anaibuka mshindi. Huu ni mwangwi wa kifalsafa unaotukumbusha usemi usemao kidole kimoja hakiwezi kuua chawa na umoja ni ushindi siku zote. Hii ndiyo falsafa ile ile inayodhihirika katika tamthilia ya “Nguzo Mama” (2007) ya Penina Muhando. Tamthilia ya *Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu* inaonekana kupanga njama yake kwa kutumia aina mbili za mada - mada kuu na ndogo. Vichwa vikuu (na vichwa vidogo kwenye mabano) vilivyotumika ni: Sehemu ya Kwanza (Neno), Sehemu ya Pili (Kishazi), Sehemu ya Tatu (Vifungu), Sehemu ya Nne (Sentensi), Sehemu ya Tano (Muundo), Sehemu ya Sita (Ibara), na Sehemu ya Saba (Insha). Tunapoyatazama maneno yaliyotumika kama vipashio vidogo vya kubainisha ploti, tunagundua kuwa maneno haya yanatokana na taaluma ya Isimu – Mofolojia na Sintaksia jinsi inavyofafanuliwa na kujadiliwa katika Massamba, Kihore, Hokororo (2012), na pia katika nyanja ya stadi za mawasiliano. Maneno haya si maneno tu bali ni dhana za kitaaluma zinazorejelea vipengele vya kimsingi katika taaluma hizi mbili. Kiisimu, tunatambua kwamba haya ni istilahi zinazobeba maana za kiufundi za neno husika, ingawa, hadi sasa, hapajapata kuwa na maafikiano kuhusu maana au dhana hizi—“neno,” “maneno,” “kifungu,” “sentensi,” “tunzi,” “aya,” na “insha” (Kipacha, 2005). Ingawa hakuna maafikiano, ni lazima tukubali kwamba kuna maelezo ya kitaaluma yanayotolewa na wataalamu wa isimu. Kwa hivyo, kupitia maelezo haya, tutaweza kuona iwapo uteuzi wa istilahi hizi za kiisimu unabeba mantiki ya uasiliano kati ya kazi ya kifasihi bunifu na taaluma ya isimu. Kwa muktadha huo, dhamira zinazopatikana katika tamthilia ya *Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu* zimerahisisha kwa kiasi kikubwa tafsiri ya tamthilia ya *Nguzo Mama* ambayo imetolewa kwa mafumbo. Hii ni kusema, kuna mazungumzo ya kifalsafa na dhana kati ya Anitha E. Mgimba na Penina Muhando kupitia mjadala wa kutafuta njia bora ya kumkomboa mwanamke. Mazungumzo hayo si mengine bali ni falsafa kwamba kidole kimoja pekee hakiwezi kuponda chawa. Hii ina maana kwamba ukombozi wa kweli wa mwanamke hauwezi kupatikana kwa juhudi zake binafsi pekee, bila kushirikiana na wanaume kuondoa pingu zinazowabana wanawake katika nyanja zote za maisha ya mwanadamu. Ndiyo maana Anitha anahitimisha mchezo wake kwa kusema, “[...]. Nakwambia mjomba, sitarudi tena! [...] Ninashukuru kwamba umoja wetu umenipa ushindi dhidi ya njama za waeneza sumu. Hakika, kidole kimoja pekee hakiwezi kuua chawa.

Majina ya Sura / Majina ya Viwanja

Vichwa vya sura au mada za njama ni vichwa vya mada vilivyochaguliwa na mwandishi ili kutenganisha sehemu.

Kwa mujibu wa Kamusi ya Kiswahili Sanifu (TUKI, 2013), neno “neno” limefafanuliwa kuwa ni kundi la sauti zinazosemwa au kuandikwa pamoja ili kuleta maana. Na hivyo basi, maneno yanapowekwa katika vipashio mbalimbali ambavyo bado havijafikia hadhi ya kishazi au sentensi, huitwa tungo (Kipacha, 2005). Kwa hivyo, neno na neno lingine huunda kifungu. Vilevile vishazi vinapowekwa pamoja huunda vishazi. Massamba (2004) anafafanua kifungu kuwa ni "ujenzi wenye kiima na kiima ambacho kipo ndani ya ujenzi mkuu." Vishazi kadhaa vinaungana na kuunda sentensi; na sentensi kadhaa zinapoletwa pamoja, huunda muundo, ambao kisha huunda aya, na aya kwa upande wake hutoa insha. Sentensi ni muundo unaojitosheleza ambao kimsingi huhusisha kitendo na wakala (TUKI, 2013). Kamusi hii ya Kiswahili Sanifu (TUKI, 2013) inafasili neno "tungo" kuwa ni kitengo cha kimuundo kinachotokana na mpangilio wa mawasiliano, mofolojia na sintaksia, pamoja na mkabala unaowiana na fani fulani ya utafiti. Kama tulivyoona katika tamthilia za Ngoswe Penzi Kitovu cha Uzembe na Nje – Ndani, hii inathibitisha bila shaka mwingiliano wa matini katika uteuzi na ubainishaji wa majina katika tamthilia ya Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu na taaluma ya isimu – mofolojia, na kati ya tamthilia ya Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu na tamthilia nyinginezo, kama vile Ngoswe Penzi Kitovu cha Uzembe na Ndani. Mythology ya Alama
pamoja na mchanganyiko wa vipashio rahisi kuunda kitengo kikubwa zaidi, na insha inafafanuliwa kuwa muundo wa maneno katika umbo la nathari kuhusu somo fulani. Kutokana na maelezo haya, tunagundua kwamba neno (au maneno) huunda vishazi, na vishazi hivi vinaunda vishazi, na vishazi huunda sentensi, na kisha sentensi huunda utunzi, utunzi huunda aya, na aya kadhaa huunda insha. Kwa hiyo, tunachokiona hapa ni kwamba mwandishi amepanga matukio yao kutoka tukio dogo hadi tukio kubwa zaidi; yaani, walianza na jambo dogo ambalo lilizaa kubwa zaidi, ambalo lilisababisha jambo kubwa zaidi, kisha kubwa zaidi, na hatimaye kubwa kuliko yote, ambalo lilitokana na mlundikano wa vitu vingi. Huu ni mwingiliano kati ya fasihi na taaluma ya isimu. Hadithi za ishara ni mbinu ya kisanii inayotumia picha zinazowakilisha masimulizi ya kimsingi ya wanadamu kuhusu imani zinazohusiana na nguvu za asili na/au uchawi. Mwandishi ametumia ishara kadhaa zinazofungamana na ngano, hasa ngano za Kiafrika. Moja ya alama zinazobeba hekaya zinazojulikana miongoni mwa jamii nyingi za Kiafrika na duniani kote ni nyoka mkubwa mweusi (Joka). Kulingana na Morris (katika Shanafelt, 2014), nyoka kama ishara (hasa chatu) inahusishwa na mvua, maji, mnyororo wa kiikolojia, uzazi, na nguvu za kichawi / za kiroho, pamoja na ishara ya kifo na ufufuo. Hekaya iliyoainishwa na msomi huyu kuhusu nyoka na maana zake pia inaonekana katika maandiko matakatifu, hasa Biblia Takatifu (Mwanzo 3:14-15, Mwanzo 44:5, Kutoka 7:8-12, Hesabu 21:6-9, 1 Yohana 3:8, Ufunuo 12:9, Ufunuo 12, Ufunuo 20:17). Ndiyo maana nyoka, kama ishara, ana nguvu kubwa, inayotokana na mapokeo ya imani katika tamaduni za jamii mbalimbali, si tu barani Afrika bali duniani kote (Hambly, 1929; Lynch na Roberts, 2010; Thomas, 2011; Shanafelt, 2014). Sio tu isimu inayoonekana kuvuma ndani ya tamthilia hii, lakini pia kuna aina nyingine ya mwangwi. This resonance is a stylistic similarity between *Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu* and several other Swahili plays, for example, *Ngoswe Penzi Kitovu cha Uzembe* (1988) by Edwin Semzaba and *Nje – Ndani* (2016) by A. A. Majid Mswahili and M. S. Njonjolo. Edwin Semzaba ametumia ujuzi kutoka katika taaluma ya Jiomofolojia kuteua na kutambulisha ploti ili kuonyesha mzizi wa tatizo hadi athari zake. Utambulisho huu umetumia dhana zifuatazo kwa mfuatano: Kijito - Mito - Mto - Mkondo - Baharini. Vilevile, A. A. Majid Mswahili na M. S. Njonjolo wametumia mbinu za taaluma ya afya na utabibu kuchagua na kubainisha viwanja vyao ili kubainisha mzizi wa tatizo hadi athari zake. Walitumia mlolongo wa udhihirisho wafuatayo: Kichochezi cha Awali - Dalili ya Kwanza (Papule) - Dalili ya Pili (Papules) - Dalili ya Tatu (Nodule) - Dalili ya Nne (Jipu) - Dalili ya Tano (Majipu) - Dalili ya Sita (Kidonda). Maelezo haya yanatuongoza kutambua kwamba matumizi ya joka, hasa nyoka wa kutisha, katika kazi za ubunifu si kitu kipya bali ni mwendelezo wa mazoezi ya kisanii ya kuchora kutoka kwa tamaduni za kijamii-mila-na kuzijumuisha katika kazi mpya za ubunifu. Katika tamthilia ya Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu, mwandishi anaonyesha uhusiano uliopo kati ya ishara ya nyoka na maana yake kuhusiana na ngano. Ndiyo kusema, nyoka mkubwa hutumika kizushi kuwasilisha taarifa kuhusu tukio linaloikabili jamii husika. Tunanukuu:
Hivyo basi, tamthilia ya Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu inadhihirisha athari ya stadi za mawasiliano na taaluma ya isimu—Mofolojia na Sintaksia—katika uteuzi na ubainishaji wa mada zake za ploti. Zaidi ya hayo, tamthilia hii pia inajihusisha na mazungumzo ya kimtindo (kupitia uteuzi na utambuzi wa majina ya viwanja) yenye tamthilia za awali kama vile Ngoswe Penzi Kitovu cha Uzembe na Nje – Ndani. Inatokea kwamba kutokea kwa nyoka huyu mkubwa mweusi katika familia ya Damiano kwa kweli ilikuwa ishara—onyo la kifo—kama Caroline alivyoeleza: “[…] Kulingana na desturi zetu, ukiona nyoka wa namna hii, jambo baya litatokea katika familia hiyo au ukoo huo.” sijui....! Ni nini sasa, kwa uaminifu? "Wacha tusubiri; tutasikia juu yake." Zaidi ya hayo, nyoka huyo alionyesha kuwepo kwa nguvu za kichawi ambazo zinaweza kuleta madhara kwa familia au ukoo. Kama Morris (katika Shanafelt, 2014) alisema, nguvu za kichawi zinaweza kutumia nyoka kama moja ya alama za mythological. Kupitia dondoo hizi, tunaona kuwa tamthilia ya *Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu* ina vipengele vya kiishara baina ya matini zinazoakisi ngano za kudumu za Waafrika pamoja na jamii nyinginezo nje ya Bara la Afrika. Aidha, matumizi ya nyoka kama ishara ya kisanaa hayakomei katika tamthilia hii pekee bali pia yanajitokeza katika kazi nyinginezo za kibunifu za Kiswahili. Fasihi simulizi, kama sanaa ya kale, mara nyingi huajiri nyoka wakubwa na viumbe vingine kuwakilisha Mungu, miungu, roho, wanadamu, au dhana fulani kupitia taswira. Kwa hivyo, taswira ya viumbe kama vile nyoka wakubwa ni sehemu ya utajiri unaobebwa katika masimulizi ya kimapokeo, ambayo pia tunayaona katika fasihi simulizi na maandishi ya kimapokeo (Bertoncini, 1989; Madumulla, 2009). Baadhi ya kazi za kidhahania zinazohusisha matumizi ya nyoka mkubwa kiishara na kimaana, ambazo tunaweza kuzihusisha na tamthilia ya *Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu*, ni pamoja na: *Adili na Ndugu Zake* (Robert, 1952), *Mtu Maarufu katika Historia ya Usukuma* (Boaz, 1974), *Hussein 1, *Gibegi ya Jadi,* (Masatu, hakuna mwaka), *Mla-Mtu Nondo*, *Nunda-Mla-Mtu na Hadithi Nyingine* (Hellier, 1964), *Ngoma ya Ng’wanamalundi* (Mbogo, 1988), na *Ngozi ya Nyoka* (Kezilahabi, 2006). Kazi hizi ni za zamani kuliko tamthilia tuliyoichunguza. Imani yetu ni kwamba, kwa kuwa mwandishi alisoma kazi za kubuni za waandishi na mitindo mbalimbali katika kozi hiyo

THEORETICAL FRAMEWORK  
These principles are: (i) it is not easy and indeed impossible to view a text as a product that is an orphan, in its own uniqueness and in isolation; instead, we must recognize that there are preceding texts that are related to the new text; (ii) texts interact and influence each other, so to think that a literary text is self-sufficient and independent is willful blindness; and (iii) an artistic text invites certain modes of expression and specific codes which help to signal an idea, event, work, or another subsequent work—thereby creating an impact on the creative work that follows (Kristeva, 1980). Based on these principles, we can say that intertextuality is a theory and academic skill that examines, identifies, and explains the relationships that exist between one text and another, in order to determine the direct or indirect (echoed) effects resulting from the interactions and mutual reinforcement of these texts. In other words, the theory of intertextuality is a guide for analyzing works of art, with a focus on literary texts, to determine the existence of borrowing or dialogue; that is, resemblance in genre, theme, and technique between one text and another. SUMMARY OF THE PLAY OUR COHESION OUR TRIUMPH  
Our Cohesion Our Triumph is a Swahili play with a strong feminist orientation, synthesizing the effects of the behaviors and actions of certain members of society who perpetuate misguided beliefs, envy, hatred, selfishness, and various forms of abuse toward others.  
In the agricultural sector, Sumukuvu (mycotoxin) refers to a poison or toxic chemicals produced by a type of fungus known as Kuvu, which grows and frequently attacks food crops and oil-yielding plants, especially those with leaves and seeds, notably cereals, legumes, roots, groundnuts, and animal feeds either on the farm or in storage.

discourses.source_txt: Even the writing of this play employs various techniques and draws from a broader world that includes fictional texts, sociological texts, feminist perspectives, and real-life experiences that dominate our societies. INTERTEXTUALITY IN OUR COHESION OUR TRIUMPH  
The analysis conducted on this play has revealed that there is a great deal of intertextuality present within it. discourses.source_txt: This is indisputable evidence that this play was not created out of thin air, but rather the writer drew knowledge, skills, and experience from the sacred writings of the religion that raised and nurtured him, as we noted in the writer’s biography. discourses.source_txt: Allegory is an artistic device used by a writer to choose a name that reflects the character, behavior, and experiences of a character in the work they are creating. For example, a writer may name their character “Hasidi” (The Envious One). To justify this name, the writer must develop that character to act with envy from beginning to end. The selection and creation of characters whose traits align with their names is the artistic technique known as allegory.
discourses.translated_txt: Allegory ni kifaa cha kisanii kinachotumiwa na mwandishi kuchagua jina linaloakisi tabia, tabia na tajriba ya mhusika katika kazi anayounda. Kwa mfano, mwandishi anaweza kutaja mhusika wao “Hasidi” (Mwenye Wivu). Ili kuhalalisha jina hili, ni lazima mwandishi amkuze mhusika huyo ili kutenda kwa husuda mwanzo hadi mwisho. Uteuzi na uundaji wa wahusika ambao sifa zao zinalingana na majina yao ni mbinu ya kisanaa inayojulikana kama mafumbo.

discourses.source_txt: Normally, these characters possess the traits of flat characters (those who do not undergo changes in character) in order to justify their names, because if they were to change in character, their names would no longer correspond to their new traits. Therefore, in terms of character and stance, these characters remain unchanged from the beginning to the end of the play. Mlacha and Madumulla (1991) describe such characters as ones who do not appear to grow in character, actions, or psychologically.
discourses.translated_txt: Kwa kawaida, wahusika hawa huwa na sifa za wahusika bapa (wale ambao hawafanyi mabadiliko ya tabia) ili kuhalalisha majina yao, kwa sababu ikiwa wangebadilika tabia, majina yao hayatalingana tena na sifa zao mpya. Kwa hivyo, kwa upande wa wahusika na msimamo, wahusika hawa hubaki bila kubadilika tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho wa tamthilia. Mlacha na Madumulla (1991) wanawaeleza wahusika hao kuwa ni wale ambao hawaonekani kukua kitabia, kimatendo, wala kisaikolojia.

discourses.source_txt: The main goal of this approach is to persuade the public to embrace good deeds and names that embody goodness, so as to reject evil and oppose the use of names that carry negative meanings, since African societies believe that a name shapes the character of the individual.

discourses.source_txt: In the agricultural sector, a mycotoxin is a poison or toxic chemical produced by certain types of fungi known as molds, which primarily infest and attack food and oil crops derived from leafy plants and seeds, especially cereals, legumes, roots, groundnuts, and animal fodder, either in the field or in storage facilities.
discourses.translated_txt: Katika sekta ya kilimo, mycotoxin ni sumu au kemikali yenye sumu inayozalishwa na aina fulani za fangasi wanaojulikana kama ukungu, ambao kimsingi hushambulia na kushambulia mazao ya chakula na mafuta yanayotokana na mimea ya majani na mbegu, hasa nafaka, kunde, mizizi, karanga na malisho ya wanyama, iwe shambani au kwenye hifadhi.

discourses.source_txt: Mycotoxin cannot be seen with the naked eye but is detected through special laboratory tests. Indicators of the presence of mycotoxin in a crop include the affected crop (seed) appearing rotten or having a color different from its original one.
discourses.translated_txt: Mycotoxin haiwezi kuonekana kwa macho lakini hugunduliwa kupitia vipimo maalum vya maabara. Viashiria vya uwepo wa sumu ya mycotoxin kwenye zao ni pamoja na zao lililoathirika (mbegu) kuonekana limeoza au kuwa na rangi tofauti na asili yake.

discourses.source_txt: This quotation confirms the existence of intertextuality between the play Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu and the academic field of agriculture. Philosophical and Conceptual Echo

An echo is a sound that is repeated after being produced, such as when a person shouts inside a cave or forest, while philosophy refers to the study of the nature, meaning, and reasons for things, as well as wisdom and prudence (Kamusi ya Kiswahili Sanifu, 2013). Therefore, a philosophical echo is a sound that is repeated after being produced through the study of the nature, meaning, and reasons for things, as well as wisdom and prudence.

Mwangwi ni sauti inayorudiwa kurudiwa baada ya kuzalishwa, kama vile mtu anapopiga kelele ndani ya pango au msitu, huku falsafa inarejelea uchunguzi wa asili, maana na sababu za mambo, pamoja na hekima na busara (Kamusi ya Kiswahili Sanifu, 2013). Kwa hiyo, mwangwi wa kifalsafa ni sauti inayorudiwa baada ya kuzalishwa kupitia uchunguzi wa asili, maana, na sababu za mambo, pamoja na hekima na busara.

discourses.source_txt: The title serves as the identifier of the chapter or scenes within a written play. The play *Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu* appears to organize its plot using two types of titles – main and sub-titles.
discourses.translated_txt: Kichwa hutumika kama kitambulisho cha sura au matukio ndani ya mchezo ulioandikwa. Tamthilia ya *Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu* inaonekana kupanga njama yake kwa kutumia aina mbili za mada - mada kuu na ndogo.

discourses.source_txt: The main titles (and sub-titles in brackets) used are: Part One (Word), Part Two (Phrase), Part Three (Clauses), Part Four (Sentence), Part Five (Composition), Part Six (Paragraph), and Part Seven (Essay). When we look at the words used as sub-titles to identify the plot, we find that these words are derived from the field of Linguistics – Morphology and Syntax as described and discussed in Massamba, Kihore, and Hokororo (2012), as well as in the field of communication skills.

Tunapoyatazama maneno yaliyotumika kama vipashio vidogo vya kubainisha ploti, tunagundua kuwa maneno haya yanatokana na taaluma ya Isimu – Mofolojia na Sintaksia jinsi inavyofafanuliwa na kujadiliwa katika Massamba, Kihore, Hokororo (2012), na pia katika nyanja ya stadi za mawasiliano.

discourses.source_txt: Moreover, the use of the snake as an artistic symbol is not limited to this play alone but also appears in other Kiswahili creative works.

discourses.source_txt: Oral literature, as an ancient art form, often employs large snakes and other creatures to represent God, gods, spirits, humans, or certain concepts through imagery. Kwa hivyo, taswira ya viumbe kama vile nyoka wakubwa ni sehemu ya utajiri unaobebwa katika masimulizi ya kimapokeo, ambayo pia tunayaona katika fasihi simulizi na maandishi ya kimapokeo (Bertoncini, 1989; Madumulla, 2009).

discourses.source_txt: Some of the imaginative works featuring the use of the large snake both symbolically and in meaning, which we can associate with the play *Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu*, include: *Adili and His Brothers* (Robert, 1952), *A Famous Person in the History of Usukuma* (Boaz, 1974), *Traditional Shield* (Hussein, 1976), *Hero Gishegu* (Masatu, no year), *The Man-Eating Nondo*, *The Man-Eating Nunda and Other Stories* (Hellier, 1964), *The Dance of Ng’wanamalundi* (Mbogo, 1988), and *The Snake’s Skin* (Kezilahabi, 2006). In all these works, the use of the large snake carries an element of magical wonder, signifying, among other things, wealth, death, protection and security, healing and health, witchcraft, fertility, oppression, suffering, and authority.
